symptomShortText: Shaft outer diameter undersize after insert change on turning lathe L1 - wear offset not reset

causesIshikawa.description: Setter changed the insert at shift start as scheduled
Insert change procedure DOC-4410 Rev B has no step to reset the wear offset - L1 kept the old offset after the insert change
Bar stock 42CrMo4 lot BS-3391 hardness 285 HB, inside specification
Air gauge AG-0207 mastered at shift start

fiveWhyChain.question: Why were the shafts below the lower diameter tolerance?
fiveWhyChain.answer: Outer diameter measured 24.921mm against 24.950-25.000mm on parts turned on L1

fiveWhyChain.question: Why did L1 cut undersize after the insert change?
fiveWhyChain.answer: The CNC kept the wear offset of the previous insert, so the new insert cut 0.03mm deeper

fiveWhyChain.question: Why was the wear offset not reset? (root cause)
fiveWhyChain.answer: The insert change procedure DOC-4410 has no offset reset step and the controller does not prompt for it

actions.actionText: Quarantine batch B-70380 and gauge the outer diameter of all S150 shafts in stock
Correct the tool wear offset in the WC-TURN-02 L1 turning program and re-release the first-off part
Add insert tool-life counter with automatic offset reset to the CNC controller on all turning cells

fmeaLink.description: Diameter drift from wear offset not reset after insert change

lessonsLearned.whatWorked: First-off measurement after the insert change caught the shift before parts left the cell
lessonsLearned.whatDidnt: The procedure relied on the setter remembering the offset reset - no system prompt

isIsNot.isWhereWhenItHappens: S150 outer diameter - WC-TURN-02-L1 - first 96 parts after the insert change on 2026-06-11
isIsNot.isNotWhereWhenItDoesnt: WC-TURN-02-L2 - parts turned on L1 before the insert change
isIsNot.notes: Defect starts at the insert change and stays on L1
